scripts.build: npm run build -w nativecorejs && npm run build -w create-nativecore
scripts.publish:check: npm run build && npm pack --dry-run ./packages/nativecorejs && npm pack --dry-run ./packages/create-nativecore
scripts.publish:all: npm run publish:runtime && npm run publish:cli
scripts.create:sample: npm run clean:sample && node packages/create-nativecore/bin/index.mjs sample-nativecore --defaults
scripts.create:sample:packed: npm run clean:sample && node packages/create-nativecore/bin/index.mjs sample-nativecore --defaults
scripts.verify:sample: npm run install:sample && npm run compile:sample
scripts.smoke:sample: npm run build && npm run create:sample && npm run verify:sample
scripts.verify:runtime:pack: npm run build && npm run pack:runtime
scripts.verify:sample:packed: npm run install:sample:packed && npm run compile:sample
scripts.smoke:sample:packed: npm run verify:runtime:pack && npm run create:sample:packed && npm run verify:sample:packed
scripts.package:vscode-all: npm run package:vscode-refs && npm run package:vscode-snippets && npm run package:vscode-diagnostics && npm run package:vscode-routes && npm run package:vscode-explorer && npm run package:vscode-contract && npm run package:vscode-generators && npm run package:vscode-sync && npm run package:vscode-ssg && npm run package:vscode-templates && npm run package:vscode-env && npm run package:vscode-fixtures && npm run package:vscode-test && npm run package:vscode-stores && npm run package:vscode-middleware && npm run package:vscode-registry && npm run package:vscode-pair && npm run package:vscode-importmap && npm run package:vscode-orphans && npm run package:vscode-signals && npm run package:vscode-devtools && npm run package:vscode-params && npm run package:vscode-pack
scripts.publish:vscode:check: node -e "const miss=[]; if(!process.env.OVSX_PAT) miss.push('OVSX_PAT'); if(!process.env.VSCE_PAT) miss.push('VSCE_PAT (optional for Marketplace)'); console.log(miss.length?('Missing: '+miss.join(', ')):'Tokens present'); process.exit(miss.includes('OVSX_PAT')?1:0)"
